bindings.expected: real Penflow positive subprocess check passes with the pinned CLI
bindings.justification: validate_review_contract runs the real Penflow C20 subprocess on a valid contract without raising, and the contract bytes stay unchanged.

bindings.expected: real Penflow negative subprocess check rejects a malformed contract
bindings.justification: The real CLI rejects a contract missing a test_id with review_contract_validation_failed, and the contract bytes stay unchanged.
With no override, no penflow beside the interpreter and an empty PATH, approval raises review_contract_penflow_cli_required: penflow not found.

bindings.expected: unit-tests checkout pins the full public commit with no credential
bindings.justification: The single Penflow checkout step's with-mapping equals exactly repository julien-m/penflow, ref dd356b95..., persist-credentials false and path, so no ssh-key or token is present.

bindings.expected: integration-3a checkout pins the full public commit with no credential
bindings.justification: Same exact with-mapping assertion for the integration-3a job.
The shipped workflow text contains no PENFLOW_READONLY_DEPLOY_KEY secret reference.

bindings.expected: real pinned CLI is installed before unit pytest consumers
bindings.justification: The Penflow checkout cleanup, which follows checkout and install, precedes every pytest step, so tests run against the installed real CLI.

bindings.expected: real pinned CLI is installed before integration pytest consumers
bindings.justification: Same ordering assertion for the integration-3a job.

bindings.expected: real CLI is installed from the pinned checkout path
bindings.justification: The install step runs uv pip install on exactly the pinned .ci-deps/penflow checkout, not a stub or index package.

bindings.expected: unit-tests checkout precedes install, which precedes cleanup
bindings.justification: Checkout, install and cleanup appear in that order in the unit-tests job.

bindings.expected: integration-3a checkout precedes install, which precedes cleanup
bindings.justification: Same ordering assertion for the integration-3a job.

bindings.expected: real CLI is installed from the pinned checkout path in integration-3a
bindings.justification: Same exact install command assertion for the integration-3a job.

bindings.expected: no job keeps a Penflow capability gate
bindings.justification: Neither Penflow job contains the former Require read-only Penflow capability step.

bindings.expected: workflow references no Penflow key variable
bindings.justification: The shipped workflow text contains no PENFLOW_KEY environment reference.
